title: QuickBooks Online gets no apostrophe before a line starting with =
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a test location whose QuickBooks Online connection is active, linked to a QuickBooks sandbox company you can sign in to.
  • Make sure Require Tech Story is off (Settings, then the Work Orders tab).
  • Create a work order for this test, work order 1, with one labor line, line 1, titled "=Replace hose" with the description "leaking".
  • Have line 1 completed with no tech story, and work order 1 completed and invoiced today as invoice A, which reaches the QuickBooks sandbox.
  • Write down invoice A's number.
  • Keep the QuickBooks sandbox company open in a second browser tab.
custom_steps:
1. In the QuickBooks tab, search for invoice A's number.
  2. Open invoice A.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • QuickBooks lists invoice A (work order 1's invoice) for its customer.

Step 2:

  • Invoice A opens.
  • Line 1's Description in QuickBooks reads exactly "=Replace hose - leaking".
  • No apostrophe sits in front of "=": the apostrophe is only for the downloaded report.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It?" (Title and Description), Confluence 845348896, version 16 (27 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 28 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11257, story SV-10132 (Story 3, What Reaches QuickBooks)

  • S3-R8a: “In the downloadable Customer Invoice report only, a line text that starts with =, +, -, @, a tab or a carriage return gets one apostrophe in front of it, so a spreadsheet opens it as text and never as a formula. This is the same guard the newer report downloads already use. The old line always started with "What are you doing?: ", so it could not open as a formula; a line that now starts with the Title can. The live QuickBooks sync never carries the apostrophe.”
  • S3-R4: “The same text is used by the live QuickBooks sync and by the downloadable Customer Invoice report. Built at the same moment, the two never show different text for the same line, apart from the leading apostrophe the report adds in S3-R8a. An invoice already in QuickBooks keeps its old text there (S3-N1, S3-E4).”

From: Product's answers to our questions 9-14 (Chris Ward, 27 Oct 2026, Google Doc 1QcT7FRZci6AhYcI33HUac-Oob03-gCnCOKn2NFHMLjA, saved in po-answers-2026-10-27/), read 28 Oct 2026

  • Answer 11: “11. Testers should expect plain text. In the downloaded Customer Invoice report, a line starting with =, +, -, @, a tab or a carriage return gets one apostrophe in front, the same guard our newer report downloads use. QuickBooks never gets the apostrophe. The build has no guard yet, so please log a bug against new S3-R8a.”

Not yet checked against a build by us: the QA build (sv10130.qa.shopview.com, QuickBooks host qb1.qa.shopview.com) and staging carry this change, and this case has not been run on either.
